description: Atmospheric methane concentration from NOAA ESRL — monthly readings in ppb (parts per billion) since 1983. Methane is the second most important greenhouse gas after CO2. Returns last 10 years by default.

years.description: Number of years of data to return (1-50, default 10). Data is monthly.

name: climate.indicators.methane

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: Atmospheric Methane (CH4)
